svg.aria-label: Three ways to shrink what a query attends to, each starting from a long column of N keys. Project the sequence, 2020: a learned k by N matrix E squashes the N keys and values into k rows with k much smaller than N, so the scores are N by k. Pick landmarks, 2021: m landmarks such as segment means stand in for the keys and the N by N score matrix is approximated as (N by m)(m by m) pseudo-inverse (m by N). A small latent array, 2021: M learned latents cross-attend to the N inputs once, N by M, then every further layer works on the M latents, M by M. All three trade exact token-to-token detail for a smaller matrix.
svg.text: shrink what you attend to, not how you store it
learned E squashes K and V
all three trade exact token-to-token detail for a smaller matrix
